guidance.title: Application Checklist & Next Steps
guidance.subtitle: Ensure zero rejections by preparing certified documentation before visiting the channel partner
guidance.doc1Desc: Valid Scheduled Caste certificate issued by competent authority (Tehsildar / Sub-Divisional Magistrate).
guidance.doc2Desc: Annual family income certificate confirming family income is ≤ ₹5,00,000 per annum.
guidance.doc3Desc: Aadhaar linked with mobile and active bank account (DBT enabled).
guidance.doc4Desc: Project summary for business loans outlining machinery, raw material, and expected revenue.
guidance.doc5Desc: Valid quotation from authorized dealers for tools, equipment, or vehicles to be financed.
guidance.doc6Desc: Proof of admission, recognized college brochure, and official fee schedule breakdown.
